messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=autoscaler-queue — queue_backlog_v2 > 75% for 3m. Link: <https://pd.example/incident/12345>
PagerDuty: Incident 12345 triggered and paged the on-call rotation.
Emily Chen: Acked. I'm on it. Looking at autoscaler metrics and kube events.
Raj Patel: I can see pods in Pending with reason=InsufficientGPU and nodegroup scaling failing. Cloud API returning quota errors.
Marta Gomez: Confirmed in cloud console — GPU quota for us-west-2 is at max. No spare GPU capacity.
Chris Liu: Ouch. Can we fall back to CPU-only model variants for burst traffic while we sort quota?
Emily Chen: Trying to scale node group manually to force extra CPU nodes, will also try a CPU-only temporary nodepool.
Emily Chen: ```
kubectl get hpa -n inference autoscaler-queue
kubectl describe deployment autoscaler-worker -n inference
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize rg-inference-pool --region=us-west2 --size=8
``` 
Emily Chen: gcloud resize returned: "Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_V100' exceeded for project." Can't add GPU nodes.
Marta Gomez: I'm creating a cpu-burst nodepool in us-west-2 (cpu-optimized). ETA ~4m. Starting now.
PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Emily Chen at 2794501240.
Raj Patel: While nodes spin up, lowering batch size to reduce queue pressure and memory usage. Pushing config change.
Raj Patel: ```
# autoscaler config change
autoscaler:
  batch_max: 4
  target_queue_ms: 200
```
Chris Liu: I'm going to shift a portion of traffic to cpu-quant model variant (lower perf but no GPU) — apply routing change now.
IncidentBot: :information_source: Routing change applied — 20% traffic shifted to cpu-quant (rollout r-2026-03-14-01).
Emily Chen: Monitoring metrics: p99 token latency at 1.8s (baseline 0.9s). Error rate up to 1.2% (HTTP 503) from three enterprise customers, investigating request traces.
Marta Gomez: Notifying CS and preparing a short customer message. Opening incident ticket INC-2026-007 for external comms.
Chris Liu: Nodepool creation succeeded and nodes are joining cluster, kubelet registering.
IncidentBot: :tada: Nodepool cpu-burst-24 created and nodes are being added to cluster.
Emily Chen: New nodes are scheduling pods, Pending count dropping. Autoscaler catching up and backfilling.
Raj Patel: Queue length is trending down — reducing the cpu-quant traffic shift to 0% gradually.
PagerDuty: Incident status updated: mitigated. Assigned to Emily Chen. Please confirm next steps and follow-ups.
Emily Chen: Mitigation complete — queue utilization <20%, latency trending back towards baseline, customer 503s resolved. Will file a follow-up runbook: quota alerting + automated CPU-fallback routing + improved playbook for manual nodepool.
Marta Gomez: Passing to night on-call @Chris Liu for postmortem and action items. Chris, can you own cloud quota requests and the automated fallback implementation?
Chris Liu: Will do. I'll open tickets for quota increase, add automated fallback to routing rules, and add an HPA tweak to avoid hitting gpu-only bottleneck.
Emily Chen: Thanks all — closing the pager. :white_check_mark:
_note: thread contains root message and chronological replies; messages are short/informal and include bot updates, commands, and handoff.
